info.description: The Competitive Exam Preparation page (/academics/assessment/competitive-exam-preparation/) — one named field per band of the page, in the order a reader meets them. ⚠ Every band is the same shape: a label, a heading, paragraphs, photographs and a run of cells. These pages carry no photographs; what differs between bands is how the page draws them, and the page owns that. Bands cannot be reordered, added or removed.
